# LIGHTNINGASIC

Founded in 2013 by JACK LIAO, specializing in AI and blockchain hardware innovation.

## Products

- HardID Hardware Wallet: Fully open-source, air-gapped hardware wallet with dual EAL6+ secure elements. Keys never leave the device. Clear Sign, FIDO2/U2F passkeys, reproducible builds.
  Docs: https://lightningasic.com/hardid.html

- BitcoinBall: Bitcoin miners built into everyday home appliances — digital photo frame, smart alarm clock, smart speaker. Positive-sum home-lottery model.
  Docs: https://lightningasic.com/bitcoinball.html

- BitExchange Hardware Wallet (2014): Ultra-slim Bitcoin hardware wallet, precursor to HardID.
  Docs: https://lightningasic.com/bitexchange-wallet.html

- CryoSpring Immersion Liquid Cooling: Phase-change liquid cooling for Bitcoin mining ASICs.
  Docs: https://lightningasic.com/cryospring.html

- Zenity: Smart luxury jewelry. https://zenity.top

- IClawMini: AI edge computing device. https://iclawmini.com

## About

LIGHTNINGASIC built the world's first Bitcoin/Litecoin dual mining machine cluster (2013-2014), pioneered immersion liquid cooling for ASIC miners, and continues developing blockchain and AI hardware solutions.
